name: pinkslip
description: Early-career job discovery, alerts, and application tooling

scripts.deploy: bun run db:migrate:remote && bun run build:frontend && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: bun run check:frontend && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun --filter @pinkslip/client check && bun --filter @pinkslip/client lint:css && bun --filter @pinkslip/web check && bun --filter @pinkslip/ios check
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && wrangler d1 migrations apply pinkslip --local
